description: Intermediate voice-group list for shikigami: one row per shikigami action category, whose entries resolve to VoiceGroupDataTable rows for actual voice selection.

Id.technical: FName primary key. ShikigamiDataTable fields Id_ShikigamiVoiceGroup_DefaultAction, _Attack, _Damage, _Down and _Unique supply lookup IDs; ShikigamiAction_FindRow walks DTM.ShikigamiVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x6F0) and returns the first typed row with this Id. None IDs are rejected. Export spells it ID.

Id_VoiceGroup.simple: VoiceGroupDataTable IDs indexed by shikigami action step/category.
Id_VoiceGroup.technical: TArray<FName>. PlayVoice selects this array by request Id: default/down/unique use index Value, attack/damage require Value>0 and use Value-1. The chosen entry resolves to a VoiceGroup row (+0x750); a random non-None voice from that group is played on the shikigami mesh, with an optional interruption rule on the owner's voice slot. No bounds check is performed on the array.

notes: Loaded as a DataTable primary asset named ShikigamiVoiceGroupDataTable into DTM.ShikigamiVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x6F0).
The join chain is ShikigamiDataTable.Id_ShikigamiVoiceGroup_* -> this row -> VoiceGroupDataTable.Id_Voice -> VoiceDataTable cues.
Only five request kinds were observed for shikigami voices (default action 1, attack 3, damage 6, down 8, unique 10); no generic system/situation/guard fields are read in the available consumer.
The companion export contains 10 available rows; retail completeness and Blueprint-only references are not asserted. Source is reconstructed retail C++ with retail RVAs recorded inline.

usages.detail: PlayVoice selects a row by shikigami action kind.
Resolves the selected Id_VoiceGroup entry to a VoiceGroup row.
Counts non-None voice candidates for the random pick.
